className.description: Additional classes added to the Compass.

dock.description: Content of the docked navigation area of the layout (React component or element)

drawerContent.description: Content rendered in an optional drawer wrapping the layout (React component or element)

drawerProps.description: Additional props passed to the drawer (Type: DrawerProps)

footer.description: Content placed at the bottom of the layout (React component or element)

header.description: Content placed at the top of the compass layout (React component or element)

isDockExpanded.description: Flag indicating the docked nav is expanded on mobile. Only applies when dock content is passed.

isDockTextExpanded.description:
Flag indicating the docked nav should display text on desktop. Only applies when dock content is passed, and
will handle toggling the visibility of the text in individual isDocked components.

isFooterExpanded.description: Flag indicating if the footer is expanded

isHeaderExpanded.description: Flag indicating if the header is expanded

isSidebarEndExpanded.description: Flag indicating if the end sidebar is expanded

isSidebarStartExpanded.description: Flag indicating if the start sidebar is expanded

main.description: Content placed at the center of the layout (React component or element)

masthead.description: The horizontal masthead content (e.g. <Masthead />). This masthead will only render when dock content is passed and only at mobile viewports. (React component or element)

sidebarEnd.description: Content placed at the horizontal end of the layout, after the main content (React component or element)

sidebarStart.description: Content placed at the horizontal start of the layout, before the main content (React component or element)
